Protocol: re2-ob, re2-ss, re2-tt (bench/\allowbreak{}re2\_investigate\_cases.yaml, excluding bench/\allowbreak{}dev\_cases.yaml); oracle alert; no shift; all sources; AI: veyltrace:investigate qwen3.5-9b-q4\_k\_m seeds 1,2,3.
